function: Learns BS beamformers for common and private messages, discrete RIS phase shifts, common-rate allocation and transmit power to maximize energy efficiency in a multi-RIS-aided RSMA downlink (p. 1-4).
system: Downlink MISO RSMA: BS with M=8 antennas, K single-antenna users, L=3 passive RISs with N elements and 2-bit discrete phases; frequency band not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: GNN on a graph of RIS, private-user and common-user nodes (D=3, q=128) with a power-control network; unsupervised, loss is negative EE plus a rate-constraint penalty (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulation: RIS channels quasi-static Rician flat-fading, direct BS-user links Rayleigh; 3 RISs at 100 m, users near 200 m; samples generated for training and testing (p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on generated channels (3200 test samples); imperfect RIS-user CSI; Table I trains with K=2, 4, 6 users and tests with K=2 to 8 (p. 4-5).
baselines: DNN [15] (PhaseNet, BeamNet, added power-control network), SCA method of [6], GNN for NOMA (own variant); DRL works [9]-[11] only cited (p. 4).
metrics: Energy efficiency versus RIS elements, maximum power and CSI error; runtime in seconds; probability of meeting the rate constraint (over 99.5%); convergence iterations (p. 4-5).
complexity: Runtime (Table II): GNN (RSMA) 0.018-0.046 s versus SCA 1.766-6.468 s over N=10-50 and K=2-6; DNN similar to GNN (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "modeled as quasi-static Rician flat-fading" - own simulator, direct links Rayleigh; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured channel is named.
q2_support: p. 5: "varying numbers of training and testing users." - Table I trains with K=2, 4 or 6 users and tests with K=2 to 8.
q3_support: p. 4: "The proposed GNN outperforms" DNN [15] and "SCA exhibits inferior" performance - learned DNN [15] and non-learned SCA [6], compared on EE (Fig. 2a).
q4_support: p. 5: "presents runtime results, indicating remarkable efficiency of" - Table II: GNN (RSMA) 0.018-0.046 s versus SCA 1.766-6.468 s.
q5_support: p. 4: "testing, channel information is generated as testing samples" - channels generated by the authors' own simulator; no code or data link and no public dataset.
notes: Multi-antenna BS (M=8) with passive RISs, so the system check passes. The GNN outputs BS beamformers, RIS phases, common rates and power level: area 3, not ISAC or NTN. Tables I-II and Figs. 2-3 read from page images of pp. 4-5; sign of the loss checked on the page 3 image. Imperfect-CSI results (Fig. 2b) are a CSI error sweep and do not count for q2.
